## DIVERTICULITIS
Oral step-down treatment
## Uncomplicated diverticulitis not requiring admission and not immunocompromised
Antimicrobials not indicated
#Inpatient ## Uncomplicated diverticulitis requiring admission or immunocompromised
Duration of therapy: Treatment duration depends on clinical response, typically
requiring 7-10 days of antimicroibal therapy.
Preferred: Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
< OR >
Piperacillin-Tazobactam 3.375g IV q6h [R]
Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
## Complicated diverticulitis (perforation, abscess, fistula, obstruction) OR meets
## sepsis criteria OR patient is immunocompromised
Consult General Surgery
Duration of therapy: Treatment duration depends on clinical response and source
control, typically requiring 10-14 days of antimicrobial therapy.
Preferred:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R]
< OR >
Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h [R,O]
Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Outpatient

Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS
## Complicated diverticulitis (perforation, abscess, fistula, obstruction) OR meets
## sepsis criteria OR patient is immunocompromised
Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS
